flags.title: Automatic renewal
flags.explanation: This renews unless you act. Note the date and the steps needed to cancel.

flags.title: They can change the terms
flags.explanation: The other party can change the agreement on its own. Check how you'd be told, and whether you can leave if you don't accept.

flags.title: Limits on their liability
flags.explanation: This limits what the other party is responsible for if something goes wrong. Check what's excluded.

flags.title: Arbitration instead of court
flags.explanation: Disputes may have to go to private arbitration, and class actions may be excluded. Check whether you can opt out.

flags.title: You cover their costs
flags.explanation: You may have to pay the other party's losses or legal costs in some situations. Check how broad this is.

flags.title: Rights to your content
flags.explanation: You may be granting rights to what you upload or create. Check whether they're perpetual, transferable, or commercial.

flags.title: Sharing your data
flags.explanation: Your information may be shared with other companies. Check with whom and why, and whether you can refuse.

flags.title: Cancellation or early-exit fee
flags.explanation: Leaving early costs money. Check the amount and when it applies.

flags.title: Price can go up
flags.explanation: The price can change during the agreement. Check how much notice you get and whether you can cancel.

flags.title: Where disputes are handled
flags.explanation: Disputes may be governed by another place's law or courts, which could make them harder to pursue from where you live.

flags.title: Limits on what you can say
flags.explanation: You may be restricted from criticizing the other party publicly. Check how long this lasts and what it covers.

flags.title: The agreement can be transferred
flags.explanation: The other party may transfer the agreement to someone else, possibly without asking you.

flags.title: Limits on guests
flags.explanation: This restricts guests in your home. If it seems unreasonable, check the Landlord and Tenant Board's guidance before relying on it.

flags.title: Restriction on competing work
flags.explanation: This limits the work you can take on after the agreement ends. Check how long it lasts, where it applies, and what work it covers.

flags.title: How the agreement ends
flags.explanation: Check the notice required to end this agreement, and any fees or conditions attached.
